# Functions, Tokens and Values

**`as_string` · `asString`**: The canonical ISO 8601 text of a date or time value.

```rhai,graph=modern
datetime("2023-08-02T09:30+02:00").as_string()   // 2023-08-02T09:30:00+02:00
```

**`between`**: the same as `P.between`, without the class name.

**`containing`**: the same as `P.containing`, without the class name.

**`date`**: A date from ISO 8601 text.

```rhai,graph=modern
date("2024-02-29").day   // 29
```

**`datetime` · `DateTime`**: A datetime from ISO 8601 text.

```rhai,graph=modern
datetime("2023-08-02T09:30Z").hour   // 9
```

**`duration`**: A duration (PostgreSQL interval).

```rhai,graph=modern
duration("P1Y2M").months   // 14
```

**`embed`**: A vector for a text from an embedder (default hash-ngram/1), computed before any traversal runs.

```rhai,graph=modern
embed("Marko") == embed("marko")   // true
```

**`empty`**: Creates a new empty graph, private to the script, and returns its traversal source.

```rhai,graph=modern
GraphSource::empty().v().count().next()   // 0
```

**`ending_with` · `endingWith`**: the same as `P.ending_with`, without the class name.

**`eq`**: the same as `P.eq`, without the class name.

**`Fake`**: A seeded generator of English test data and random numbers: the same seed and calls give the same values; without a seed it picks one (see the book page Generating test data).

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).full_name()   // Victoria Vargas
```

**`file`**: Loads a graph file (.xml/.graphml, GraphSON .json) into a new private graph (needs file access).

```rhai
GraphSource::file("modern.graphml").v().count().next()
```

**`file_tree`**: Creates a private sample graph of a file tree (directories, files, symlinks), as used by glob_path().

```rhai,graph=modern
GraphSource::file_tree().v().count().next()   // 37
```

**`gt`**: the same as `P.gt`, without the class name.

**`gte`**: the same as `P.gte`, without the class name.

**`inside`**: the same as `P.inside`, without the class name.

**`jpath`**: Builds a JSONPath property key for nested values, usable wherever a property name is (see the book page Path keys (jpath)).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(#{a: #{b: [5, 6]}}).values(jpath("a.b[1]")).to_list()   // [6]
```

**`localdatetime`**: A date and time without a zone.

```rhai,graph=modern
localdatetime("2023-08-02T09:30").hour   // 9
```

**`lt`**: the same as `P.lt`, without the class name.

**`lte`**: the same as `P.lte`, without the class name.

**`neq`**: the same as `P.neq`, without the class name.

**`not`**: the same as `P.not`, without the class name.

**`not_containing` · `notContaining`**: the same as `P.not_containing`, without the class name.

**`not_ending_with` · `notEndingWith`**: the same as `P.not_ending_with`, without the class name.

**`not_regex` · `notRegex`**: the same as `TextP.not_regex`, without the class name.

**`not_starting_with` · `notStartingWith`**: the same as `P.not_starting_with`, without the class name.

**`now`**: Script start time, the same for every call (PostgreSQL now()).

```rhai,graph=modern
now() == now()   // true
```

**`offsettime`**: A time of day with its UTC offset.

```rhai,graph=modern
offsettime("09:30+02:00").offset   // 7200
```

**`outside`**: the same as `P.outside`, without the class name.

**`regex`**: the same as `TextP.regex`, without the class name.

**`starting_with` · `startingWith`**: the same as `P.starting_with`, without the class name.

**`time`**: A time of day.

```rhai,graph=modern
time("09:30:15").second   // 15
```

**`tinkerpop_modern`**: Creates a private copy of TinkerPop's modern sample graph (6 vertices, 6 edges).

```rhai,graph=modern
GraphSource::tinkerpop_modern().e().count().next()   // 6
```

**`today`**: The date of now() in UTC or in the given zone.

```rhai,graph=modern
type_of(today())   // date
```

**`typeOf`**: the same as `P.typeOf`, without the class name.

**`UUID`**: Returns a new random UUID value.

```rhai,graph=modern
type_of(UUID())   // Uuid
```

**`vector`**: A vector value (an embedding) from a list of numbers: f32, or quantized to f16, i8 or bit.

```rhai,graph=modern
vector([0.5, -1.0], "bit").to_list()   // [1.0, -1.0]
```

**`within`**: the same as `P.within`, without the class name.

**`without`**: the same as `P.without`, without the class name.

**`By.JsonPath`**: A by() argument that reads a nested value by a JSONPath.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(#{a: #{b: 2}}, #{a: #{b: 1}}).order().by(By.JsonPath("a.b")).to_list()   // [#{"a": #{"b": 1}}, #{"a": #{"b": 2}}]
```

**`By.Property`**: A by() argument that reads the named property (the same as by("name")).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_label("person").order().by(By.Property("age")).values("name").to_list()   // ["vadas", "marko", "josh", "peter"]
```

**`By.Traversal`**: A by() argument that runs a child traversal (the same as by(__.x())).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_label("person").order().by(By.Traversal(__.out_e().count())).values("name").to_list()   // ["vadas", "peter", "josh", "marko"]
```

**`Cardinality.list`**: A property value tagged with Cardinality.list; writing it fails (one value per key, see the book page Upserts).

```rhai,graph=modern
type_of(Cardinality.list(5))   // CardinalityValue
```

**`Cardinality.set`**: A property value tagged with Cardinality.set; writing it fails (one value per key, see the book page Upserts).

```rhai,graph=modern
type_of(Cardinality.set(5))   // CardinalityValue
```

**`Cardinality.single`**: A property value tagged with Cardinality.single, for merge_v()/merge_e() option maps.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.merge_v(#{"T.id": "1"}).option(Merge.onMatch, #{age: Cardinality.single(30)}).values("age").next()   // 30
```

**`CastPolicy.Default`**: A cast policy that replaces a value that does not convert with the given fallback.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject("x", "1").as_number(GType.LONG, CastPolicy.Default(0)).to_list()   // [0, 1]
```

**`UUID.from_string` · `UUID.fromString`**: Parses a UUID value from its canonical text.

```rhai,graph=modern
UUID.from_string("123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000").as_string()   // 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```

**`Uuid.as_string` · `Uuid.asString`**: The canonical text of the UUID value.

```rhai,graph=modern
UUID.from_string("123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000").as_string().len()   // 36
```

**`temporal.as_string` · `temporal.asString`**: The canonical ISO 8601 text of a date or time value.

```rhai,graph=modern
datetime("2023-08-02T09:30+02:00").as_string()   // 2023-08-02T09:30:00+02:00
```

**`Vector.quantize`**: The vector in another element kind (f32, f16, i8, bit).

```rhai,graph=modern
vector([0.5, -1.0]).quantize("i8").dimension   // 2
```

**`Vector.to_list` · `Vector.toList`**: The values of the vector as a list of floats (dequantized).

```rhai,graph=modern
vector([0.5, 2]).to_list()   // [0.5, 2.0]
```

**`Set.of`**: A set value (duplicates dropped) of the given values, e.g. to seed a set side effect.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.with_side_effect("s", Set.of()).v().out().values("name").aggregate("s").cap("s").next()   // ["josh", "lop", "vadas", "ripple"]
```

**`Set.of_list` · `Set.ofList`**: A set value (duplicates dropped) of the elements of the given list.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.with_side_effect("s", Set.of_list(["lop"])).v().out().values("name").aggregate("s").cap("s").next()   // ["lop", "josh", "vadas", "ripple"]
```

**`Map.contains`**: Whether a map with non-string keys has the given key.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().group().by("age").next().contains(29)   // true
```

**`Map.contains_key` · `Map.containsKey`**: Whether a map with non-string keys has the given key (alias of contains()).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().group().by("age").next().contains_key(30)   // false
```

**`Map.is_empty` · `Map.isEmpty`**: Whether a map with non-string keys has no entries.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().group().by("age").next().is_empty()   // false
```

**`Map.keys`**: The keys of a map with non-string keys (group(), group_count() results).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_label("person").group_count().by("age").next().keys()   // [29, 27, 32, 35]
```

**`Map.len`**: The number of entries of a map with non-string keys.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().group().by("age").next().len()   // 4
```

**`Map.to_map` · `Map.toMap`**: Converts the map to a plain Rhai object map; fails when a key is not a string.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().group_count().by("age").next().to_map()   // error: non-string key 29
```

**`Map.values`**: The values of a map with non-string keys.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_label("person").group_count().by("age").next().values()   // [1, 1, 1, 1]
```

**`V.Auto`**: The default display format: chosen by the result's shape.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").visualize(V.Auto)
```

**`V.Json`**: Display format: JSON text.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").visualize(V.Json)
```

**`V.JsonSchema`**: Display format: the JSON Schema of the results (a schema map as JSON Schema; other results as JSON per line).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").visualize(V.JsonSchema)   // "marko"
```

**`V.Markdown`**: Display format: a Markdown table.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").visualize(V.Markdown)
```

**`V.Mermaid`**: Display format: Mermaid (a schema map as a diagram; other results as JSON per line).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").visualize(V.Mermaid)   // "marko"
```

**`V.PlantUML`**: Display format: PlantUML (a schema map as a diagram; other results as JSON per line).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").visualize(V.PlantUML)   // "marko"
```

**`V.Table`**: Display format: a text table.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").visualize(V.Table)
```

**`V.Tree`**: Display format: an indented tree.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).out().visualize(V.Tree)
```

**`GraphSource.empty`**: Creates a new empty graph, private to the script, and returns its traversal source.

```rhai,graph=modern
GraphSource::empty().v().count().next()   // 0
```

**`GraphSource.file`**: Loads a graph file (.xml/.graphml, GraphSON .json) into a new private graph (needs file access).

```rhai
GraphSource::file("modern.graphml").v().count().next()
```

**`GraphSource.file_tree`**: Creates a private sample graph of a file tree (directories, files, symlinks), as used by glob_path().

```rhai,graph=modern
GraphSource::file_tree().v().count().next()   // 37
```

**`GraphSource.tinkerpop_modern`**: Creates a private copy of TinkerPop's modern sample graph (6 vertices, 6 edges).

```rhai,graph=modern
GraphSource::tinkerpop_modern().e().count().next()   // 6
```

**`map.subgraph`**: The meta-graph of one label of a schema map (private to the script).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.infer_schema().subgraph("person").v().count().next()   // 1
```

**`map.subgraph_labels`**: The meta-graph of the given labels of a schema map (private to the script).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.infer_schema().subgraph_labels(["person", "software"]).v().count().next()   // 2
```

**`map.to_graph`**: Builds the meta-graph of a schema map: one vertex per label, one edge per declared connection (private to the script).

```rhai,graph=modern
g.infer_schema().to_graph().v().count().next()   // 2
```

**`TraversalMetrics.to_json`**: The profile as JSON text.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().count().profile().to_json().contains("count_pushdown")   // true
```

**`TraversalMetrics.to_map` · `TraversalMetrics.toMap`**: The profile as a map: duration_ns, metrics per step, optimizer_rules_applied.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().count().profile().to_map()["optimizer_rules_applied"]   // ["count_pushdown"]
```

**`TraversalMetrics.to_table`**: The profile as the text table that profile() shows.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().count().profile().to_table().contains("v().count()")   // true
```

**`Execution.to_json`**: The execution (results, error, profile) as JSON text.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().count().execute().to_json()   // {"results":[6],"error":null,"profile":null}
```

**`Execution.to_map` · `Execution.toMap`**: The execution as a map: results, error, profile, mutated, changes.

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().count().execute().to_map()["results"]   // [6]
```
